confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors come from several 2026 aggregated sources (Numbeo data republished by Expatica, plus travel guides), so they are moderately reliable, but the sources disagree on draft beer and the figures are user-submitted or blog estimates. Cocktail and wine anchors rest on bar-guide ranges and a crowd-sourced figure, so they are less certain. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July peak season and were not checked against live listings or searched. The FX observation (18 Nov 2026) was reported by a third-party aggregator citing RBA figures and a search summary of the RBA exchange-rates page; I did not open the RBA page or the F11.1 CSV directly, so verify it there before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Rome-specific aggregated price data for food and drink, with euro-denominated figures expressed in USD. Accommodation is a holistic estimate from general knowledge of Rome's July peak-season market for hostel, basic hotel and three-star categories, with no search performed.
